description: Client-only. List what join_world can join: saved singleplayer worlds (worldId sp:<folder>, name, lastPlayed in ms, joinable), newest first, and the server list entries as opaque mp: ids (the same ids session/agent memory uses; addresses and entry names are never returned). Also returns lastWorldId, the world joined last in this game run.
name: list_worlds
title: List worlds and servers
